scope: Read-only interpretation of exact installed source and previously verified immutable-image module bindings. No09 failure conclusion; no provider requests or source edits.

imageBindingEvidence.limit: Six instrumented modules byte-matched cached image; supplemental viem/config/retrieval source here is installed pinned SDK evidence, not newly extracted image-byte evidence.

interpretation.meaning: No observed entry to Archiver.sync(). Use last unfinished phase to separate store/protocol/constants/header, blob/clock/trace/history tests, initial store reads, or loop startup. It does not establish a slow history backlog.

A pass entered, but latest-header observation has not completed: initial local getL2Tips/processInboundQueue or latest-L1 getBlock awaits are among possibilities. No endpoint/error attribution possible.

Latest header returned. Work may be finalized header, message sync, checkpoint reconciliation/log scans/calldata/trace/blob/validation/store writes, pruning/finality/speculation reconciliation. The counter does not identify which await or prove useful progress.

Observed post-updater successful checkpoint batch at the Downloaded checkpoint loop. This demonstrates forward ingestion progress, not finality, total remaining backlog or readiness; later rollback remains possible.
The synchronizer advertised completion at this sampled head after message agreement and speculation gate checks. Not proof world-state/PXE/server readiness.

interpretation.observation: passesCompleted rises but local stays null/unchanged
interpretation.meaning: Whole Archiver.sync returned. A pass may return without advertising the head when messages/speculation are pending, or no new head. Completion is not initial-sync completion.

An error escaped a whole pass and was rethrown unchanged; recorded typed numeric cause helps classify it. RunningPromise catches and normally continues after polling delay. Counters count passes, not network calls/retries.

interpretation.observation: error remains set after later successful passes
interpretation.meaning: Error is last failed-pass category, not current fatal condition; recorder does not clear it on success. Correlate pass counts/inFlight and progress.

Monotonic elapsed milliseconds since recorder creation, not UTC. Progress updates only when localL1/checkpoint observed value increases vs previous. Head-only changes do not count. Snapshot timer flushes30s but does not itself advance observation time; stale timestamp is not proof dead process.
Initial wait resolved when advertised local head+1 >= another latest L1 block-number read. Remaining world-state synchronizer/verifiers/P2P/server/admin and strict query qualification still required.
Some heights were not representable withinuint32, or source/persistence/schema checks failed. Do not treat missing data as zero/backlog-free. Exact last-good snapshot may be insufficient.

samplingLimits: Single archiver pass is serial; inFlight is boolean, not a request concurrency count. Exact invariant completed+failed+(inFlight?1:0)=started.

No per-provider request counts, range cursor, byte throughput, message-recovery reason, individual current await, HTTP Retry-After delay or queue-depth counter. No metric estimates remaining sync time reliably.
Markers bracket awaits; an unfinished parent phase can contain nested operations. Fixed stage/error snapshots are trusted pinned-runtime diagnostics, not hostile-process attestation.

Errors swallowed inside subroutines before returning will not increment passesFailed; only pass-level escaped errors are classified. unknown also includes missing typed causes/depth/accessor exclusions.

defaultsAndLoad.archiverConfig: config.js maps ARCHIVER_POLLING_INTERVAL_MS default500ms, batch100. factory fallback10000ms exists but actual populated CLI config mapping overrides; bootstrap supplies no archiver override. InitialRunningPromise uses effective interval/10 (normally50ms), returns to effective500ms after initial sync.
defaultsAndLoad.http: makeL1HttpTransport uses viem fallback over one explicitURL for each role, http batch:false, optional timeout. Bootstrap has no ETHEREUM_HTTP_TIMEOUT_MS; viemHTTP default10000ms applies absent other config.
defaultsAndLoad.retry: Fallback makes inner HTTP retryCount0; outer createTransport default retryCount3/retryDelay150ms. buildRequest retries eligible errors with exponentialbackoff or HTTP Retry-After. No operator fallback is added; SDK automatic retries and subsequent passes still exist. These are defaults/source semantics, not measured09 request counts.
defaultsAndLoad.parallelism: archiver/factory seven rollup constants are Promise.all. data_retrieval processes checkpoint logs asyncPool10; l1_synchronizer fetches blobs asyncPool10 for accepted checkpoints. Other epoch/blob internals may add operations.
defaultsAndLoad.range: getBatchSizeInL1Blocks=max(1,floor(batchSize*slotDuration/ethereumSlotDuration)); nextRange nextStart=end+1, nextEnd=nextStart+size cappedathead (inclusive up to size+1 blocks). handleCheckpoints loops ranges until head in one pass; therefore one long inFlight can contain many scans. No configuredchain durations assumed here.

recommendedNextUse: At09 final receipt, compare finitephase/counter/height/error fields first. Active checkpoint/local progress can justify measuring workload duration; repeated429 or failed passes requires provider-capacity diagnosis, not automaticduration extension. Pre-loop phase wait requires narrower source-specific probe. No new paid action follows this report.
